草儿现在半昏死了过去，刚刚扎得几个穴位，便是刺激小草体内穴位，将毒血逼出，等到毒血全部排干净后，差不多就能醒过来，再疗养几日，应该可以生龙活虎，继续在石溪村当孩子王。

未来的一些年头，手里有人很重要。

要是草儿能认自己做干爹，好像倒也不错，不过这个要看草儿自己的想法了，也不着急。

李青山坐在旁边椅子上，闭目养神，静静等候。

一个小时后。

草儿脚下已经滴了一滩毒血，现在已经不滴了，李青山便将银针一根根的重新拔了出来。

果然。

银针刚刚拔出，草儿便缓缓睁开双眼。

“青山哥！”

草儿逐渐恢复了些精神，望着眼前的李青山感激道。

“你喊我哥，我喊你妈姐，这都差辈了！”

“还有，你让毒蛇咬了，怎么不和你妈说？”

“而且，你是怎么让蛇咬到你脚底板的？”

李青山望着躺在床上的草儿，倒也好奇道。

“我以为没什么大事情的，后来感觉到难受了，就不敢告诉我妈了，去诊所要花钱，我妈已经没有钱了。”

草儿脸上升起一抹委屈道。

“以后要是受伤了，一定要告诉你妈，若不是有我的话，你估计已经去见你亲爹了。”

李青山说完，便将旁边的一碗野鸡肉递给草儿道：“把这些肉吃了，早些将元气恢复了。”

“哇，这么多肉？”

“还有烙饼？”

草儿望着李青山递过来的一碗香喷喷鸡肉，小脸上顿时升起一抹激动和惊喜道：“青山哥，这些肉都是哪里来的？”

“山上打的。”

“草儿……！”

就在这时，门外的柔雪听到了动静，连忙冲了进来，在见到已经恢复了精神的女儿后，连忙将其抱在怀中痛哭起来。

李青山见状，便转身退了出去。

柔雪望着离开房门的背影，咬了咬牙嘱咐好好吃饭后，便也跟着李青山走了出去，顺便将小草的房门关上。

“青山！”

柔雪对前面的李青山喊了一声。

“嗯？”

李青山回过头来，正见到柔雪正在解开自己衣服的纽扣，咬着嘴唇，一副纯欲至极的模样，似乎是已经打算将身子交给自己了。

Cao'er is now half-conscious. The acupuncture points that have just been pricked are to stimulate the acupuncture points in Xiaocao's body and force out the poisonous blood. After all the poisonous blood is drained out, he will almost wake up. After a few more days of recuperation, he should be able to live vigorously and continue to be the king of children in Shixi Village.

In the years to come, it will be important to have someone on hand.

It would be good if Cao'er could recognize him as his godfather, but it depends on Cao'er's own thoughts, so there is no rush.

Li Qingshan sat on the chair next to him, closed his eyes and rested, waiting quietly.

An hour later.

There was already a pool of poisonous blood dripping under Cao'er's feet. Now that it has stopped dripping, Li Qingshan pulled out the silver needles one by one.

really.

As soon as the silver needle was pulled out, Cao'er slowly opened his eyes.

"Brother Qingshan!"

Cao'er gradually regained some energy and looked at Li Qingshan in front of her and said gratefully.

"You call me brother, and I call you mom, sister. This is not enough!"

"Also, you were bitten by a poisonous snake, why didn't you tell your mother?"

"And how did you get the snake to bite the sole of your foot?"

Li Qingshan looked at Cao'er lying on the bed and was curious.

"I thought it was nothing serious, but later I felt uncomfortable and didn't dare to tell my mother. It costs money to go to the clinic, and my mother no longer had any money."

Cao'er said with a hint of grievance on his face.

"If you get hurt in the future, you must tell your mother. If it weren't for me, you would have gone to see your biological father."

After Li Qingshan finished speaking, he handed the bowl of pheasant meat next to him to Cao'er and said, "Eat this meat and your energy will be restored earlier."

"Wow, so much meat?"

"And pancakes?"

Cao'er looked at the bowl of fragrant chicken handed over by Li Qingshan, and a touch of excitement and surprise suddenly appeared on his face: "Brother Qingshan, where does all this meat come from?"

"Fighted on the mountain."

"Cao'er...!"

At this moment, Rouxue heard the noise outside the door and rushed in. After seeing her daughter who had regained her energy, she quickly held her in her arms and cried bitterly.

When Li Qingshan saw this, he turned around and retreated.

Rouxue looked at the figure leaving the door, gritted her teeth and told her to have a good meal, and then followed Li Qingshan out, closing Xiaocao's door at the same time.

"Qingshan!"

Rouxue shouted to Li Qingshan in front of her.

"Huh?"

Li Qingshan turned around and saw Rouxue unbuttoning her clothes, biting her lips, looking extremely pure, as if she was already planning to give her body to him.
